inputs.model.prompt: A woman in her late twenties in a cream knit sweater sits at a sunlit kitchen counter and holds up a small glass jar of honey to the camera, smiling. She speaks directly to the camera: "This is the only honey I buy now. One spoon and you can actually taste the orange blossom." Natural room tone with a faint kettle whistle in the background, then a soft glass clink as she sets the jar down on the countertop. Handheld medium shot, warm afternoon light, shallow depth of field.
